slides.heading: Build it
items: Handles: drill two 1" holes 3" apart in each end, jigsaw between.
Glue and screw the sides to the outer slats.
Screw the ends on. Pre-drill every hole.
Sand to 180 grit. Wipe on mineral oil.
slides.tip: Clamp the board before drilling or cutting. Keep fingers clear of the jigsaw.
